## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Udayam Engineers & Builders?
No. 7, V.V. Koil Street, Tambaram Sanatorium, Chennai 600 045 (Opposite MEPZ).

### What facilities does Udayam Engineers & Builders have?
Industrial construction, Commercial buildings, Warehouses & PEB sheds, Schools & institutions, Design & build, Structural design, Regulatory approval liaison, Collaborative construction with architects, Turnkey projects, Residences.

### What do you build?
Mainly industrial and commercial buildings — factories, warehouses, offices — plus schools and institutions.

### Do you handle design and approvals?
Yes. Our design-and-build service covers planning, structural design, construction and coordination of regulatory approvals.

### Can you work with my architect?
Yes. We work closely with engineers and architects to execute their designs.

### How do I start a project with Udayam Engineers & Builders?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99941 09805.
